title: 秋夜慢慢安静
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve existing named identities, not just species. Input 1: visual continuity reference. Input 2: visual continuity reference.
Visible characters: NONE; no animals or people visible. Exact total number of visible characters: 0. Do not draw extra background animals. Scene continuity: 窗外深蓝秋夜，室内暖灯和书架形成安静对照。
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 无人环境镜头：窗外树影静止，室内书架上的盒盖合拢。
Emotional performance for this exact beat: 夜晚柔和宁静，不出现额外声响符号。
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): 无月亮特写，无字，无音符。
Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events. Continuity-specific locks: At this story point, the red leaf is the only object inside the wooden box; never add other collected sounds or objects to it. Do not depict sound as visible letters, music notes, sound waves, glowing objects, or captured material. Reference roles: Input 1: This is the same single pale honey-pine lidded box; preserve its rounded corners and small scale. Input 2: This is the same single red autumn leaf from Pipi and Rongrong’s daytime walk.Light and time lock: This exact scene occurs at night in the bedroom. Show a dark blue night sky outside the window, warm interior lamplight and no daylight. Composition and continuity override: show the bedroom BOOKSHELF clearly. Place the one CLOSED small pale pinewood box on a shelf BETWEEN books; it is not on a desk, nightstand or window ledge. This box contains only the red leaf. No characters, no other boxes, no foreground table. Night sky outside the window.
